entry.author: commercecommission
entry.summary:
We’ve refreshed our enforcement and compliance priorities for the year ahead, which set out the key behaviours and practices we'll focus on to enhance competition and improve value and choice for New Zealanders. This year, we put discussion at the heart of our webinar as our panellists, Chair Dr John Small and Deputy Chair Anne Callinan, took the opportunity to:
 
• Unpack our renewed compliance and enforcement priorities for the year ahead
• Explore what they mean in practice
• Reflect on highlights from last year's priorities
• Respond to audience questions

View the Commission's refreshed enforcement and compliance priorities: https://www.comcom.govt.nz/about-us/our-role/our-enforcement-and-compliance-priorities/
 
View our video series to help businesses understand obligations under product safety regulations & standards for children's toys, high-strength magnets, children's nightwear & hot water bottles on our website: https://www.comcom.govt.nz/business/your-obligations-as-a-business/product-safety-standards/
